translations.literal: And the Director has the merit of supporting the throne—how could he be punished for ridding the state of a villain!
translations.idiomatic: And the Director has the merit of supporting the throne—how could he be punished for ridding the state of a villain!

sentences.zh: 元素以為然，召之。

translations.literal: Yuansu agreed and summoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuansu agreed and summoned him.

sentences.zh: 注至，蠖屈鼠伏，佞辭泉湧。

translations.literal: Zhu arrived like a bent caterpillar or crouching rat; flattery poured forth like a spring.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu arrived like a bent caterpillar or crouching rat; flattery poured forth like a spring.

sentences.zh: 元素不覺執手款曲，諦聽忘倦。

translations.literal: Yuansu unconsciously took his hand in warmth, listened intently, and forgot fatigue.
translations.idiomatic: Yuansu unconsciously took his hand in warmth, listened intently, and forgot fatigue.

sentences.zh: 弘楚詗伺往復再三，元素不顧，以金帛厚遺注而遣之。

translations.literal: Hongchu watched back and forth again and again; Yuansu paid no heed, gave Zhu a rich gift of gold and silk, and sent him away.
translations.idiomatic: Hongchu watched back and forth again and again; Yuansu paid no heed, gave Zhu a rich gift of gold and silk, and sent him away.

sentences.zh: 弘楚怒曰：「中尉失今日之斷，必不免它日之禍矣！」

translations.literal: Hongchu said in fury: "Director, by failing to decide today you will surely not escape tomorrow's disaster!"
translations.idiomatic: Hongchu said in fury, "Director, by failing to decide today you will surely not escape tomorrow's disaster!"

sentences.zh: 因解軍職去。

translations.literal: He resigned his military post and left.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned his military post and left.

sentences.zh: 頃之，疽發背卒。

translations.literal: Before long a carbuncle broke out on his back and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long a carbuncle broke out on his back and he died.

sentences.zh: 王涯之為相，注有力焉，且畏王守澄，遂寢李款之奏。

translations.literal: Wang Ya had become Chancellor with Zhu's help and feared Wang Shoucheng, so he shelved Li Kuan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ya had become Chancellor with Zhu's help and feared Wang Shoucheng, so he shelved Li Kuan's memorial.

sentences.zh: 守澄言注於上而釋之，尋奏為侍御史，充右神策判官，朝野駭歎。

translations.literal: Shoucheng spoke for Zhu before the Emperor and secured his release; soon Zhu was appointed Palace Censor and judge of the Right Divine Strategy Army—court and market alike gasped in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Shoucheng spoke for Zhu before the Emperor and secured his release; soon Zhu was appointed Palace Censor and judge of the Right Divine Strategy Army—court and market alike gasped in alarm.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以前忠武節度使王智興為河中節度使。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the former Military Commissioner of Zhongwu, Wang Zhixing, was made Military Commissioner of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wang Zhixing, former military commissioner of Zhongwu, was appointed military commissioner of Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 群臣以上即位八年，未受尊號。

translations.literal: The officials noted that the Emperor had reigned eight years without receiving an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: The officials noted that the Emperor had reigned eight years without receiving an honorific title.

sentences.zh: 冬，十二月，甲午，上尊號曰太和文武仁聖皇帝。

translations.literal: Winter, twelfth month, day jiawu: the honorific title Emperor Taihe Wenwu Rensheng was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the twelfth month, on jiawu, the honorific title Emperor Taihe Wenwu Rensheng was conferred.

sentences.zh: 會有五坊中使薛季稜自同、華還言閭閻凋弊。

translations.literal: It happened that palace envoy Xue Jiling of the Five Wards, returning from Tong and Hua, reported that villages were withering.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that palace envoy Xue Jiling of the Five Wards, returning from Tong and Hua, reported that villages were withering.

sentences.zh: 上歎曰：「關中小稔，百姓尚爾，況江、淮比年大水，其人如何！

translations.literal: The Emperor sighed: "In Guanzhong we had a modest harvest and the people are still like this—what of Jianghuai, flooded year after year! How do those people fare!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sighed, "In Guanzhong we had a modest harvest and the people are still like this—what of Jianghuai, flooded year after year! How do those people fare!

sentences.zh: 吾無術以救之，敢崇虛名乎！」

translations.literal: I have no art to save them—how dare I accept empty honor!"
translations.idiomatic: I have no art to save them—how dare I accept empty honor!"

sentences.zh: 因以通天帶賞季稜。

translations.literal: He rewarded Jiling with an imperial belt instead.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded Jiling with an imperial belt instead.

sentences.zh: 群臣凡四上表，竟不受。

translations.literal: The officials submitted four memorials in all; he never accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The officials submitted four memorials in all; he never accepted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上始得風疾，不能言。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi the Emperor first suffered a wind ailment and could not speak.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Emperor first suffered a wind ailment and could not speak.

sentences.zh: 於是王守澄薦昭義行軍司馬鄭注善醫。

translations.literal: Then Wang Shoucheng recommended Zhaoyi chief of staff Zheng Zhu as skilled in medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Then Wang Shoucheng recommended Zhaoyi chief of staff Zheng Zhu as skilled in medicine.

sentences.zh: 上征注至京師，飲其藥，頗有驗，遂有龐。

translations.literal: The Emperor summoned Zhu to the capital, took his medicine, found it somewhat effective, and soon regained robust health.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor summoned Zhu to the capital, took his medicine, found it somewhat effective, and soon regained full use of his body.
